selection_rule: Reduced V1 keeps 48 evenly distributed stable logical IDs across the original 96 and maximizes silhouette, region and style breadth.
canary_rule: Do not launch bulk Accessories until all three canaries pass source-art review, locked-body fit, alpha validation and clipping review.
bulk_rule: After canary pass, produce only the remaining approved V1 IDs; never auto-expand to all 96 without explicit user instruction.
